messages:
anya (new-hire): Hey team — I'm on-call starting Mon and want to make sure I have runbook access and know the escalation path. Quick q: where are the runbooks stored and who should I ping if I can't access them?
chris (oncall-lead): Welcome! Runbooks live in Confluence -> Oncall Runbooks. TL;DR: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/x/Runbooks. Ping @jules if permissions fail.
jules (sre): I can add you. What's your SSO email? I'll also add you to the oncall-readers group.
anya (new-hire): anya@redwood.com
jules (sre): Done, give it ~5min. Also check the "pager triage checklist" at the top of the runbook.
devx-bot: Reminder: New on-call training session tomorrow 10:00am PT — RSVP: https://calendar/evt/1234 
sam (eng-manager): Also, pairing session with chris on Sunday 3pm if you want a mock pager drill.
anya (new-hire): Would love mock drill. One more: if an incident requires paging an exec, what's the wording and whom to CC?
chris (oncall-lead): Escalation matrix in runbook sec 2. Short version: page on-call escalation channel, then call the incident leader (listed there). Exec page is only for Sev1 w/ customer impact — see template: 'SEV1 — <brief impact> — <what we're doing> — <lead contact>'. CC: @vpeng @ops.
anya (new-hire): Thanks. Also can't get into the staging cluster — `kubectl get pods` times out. Anyone seen this today?
jules (sre): Staging network flapped earlier, SRE restored routing. Try `kubectl config use-context staging` then `kubectl get pods --namespace infra`. If still failing run `tailscale status` maybe the VPN hasn't connected.
anya (new-hire): `kubectl config` worked, I'm in. Thanks!
chris (oncall-lead): One more note: during first rotation you'll be paired with a shadow for 2 shifts. If you want to swap days ping me 24h ahead.
anya (new-hire): Cool, appreciate the help :thumbsup:
pagerbot: Scheduled: Anya shadow shift with Chris — Sun 15:00-23:00. Good luck! :party_parrot:
